<h2><span class="mw-headline" id="Introduction">Introduction</span></h2>
<p>Weapons, are all instruments used either in defense or attack, these objects can be blades, blunts, explosives, arsonists or firearms. Weapons are classified into:
</p>
<ul><li>Melee</li>
<li>Light
<ul><li>Crossbows</li>
<li>Pistols</li>
<li>Assault rifles</li>
<li>Events (Light)</li></ul></li>
<li>Heavy
<ul><li>Rifles and shotguns</li>
<li>Machineguns</li>
<li>Explosives and rocket launchers</li>
<li>Events (heavy)</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><br>
</p>
<h2><span class="mw-headline" id="Melee"><a href="/wiki/Category:Melee_weapons" title="Category:Melee weapons">Melee</a></span></h2>
<p>Short-range, most melee weapons have the main function of serving as tools of work and survival.
</p>
<hr>
<p><span class="mw-customtoggle-myDivision"></span></p><span class="mw-customtoggle-myDivision"><div class="floatleft"><a href="/wiki/File:Meleesphere.png" class="image"><img alt="" src="/images/thumb/Meleesphere.png/90px-Meleesphere.png?c140f2" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="90" height="90" data-file-width="244" data-file-height="244"></a></div><b><u> Melee </u></b> </span><p> Hand to hand, the basis of combat. Many melee weapons lack power, but when ammo is low, a knife or axe could be all that stands between life and death.
</p><div class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed mw-made-collapsible"><button type="button" class="mw-collapsible-toggle mw-collapsible-toggle-default mw-collapsible-toggle-collapsed" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><span class="mw-collapsible-text">Expand</span></button><div class="mw-collapsible-content" hidden="until-found">

<thead><tr>
<th style="text-align:center" class="headerSort" tabindex="0" role="columnheader button" title="Sort ascending">Pic
</th>

<h2><span class="mw-headline" id="Light_weapons"><a href="/wiki/Category:Light_weapons" title="Category:Light weapons">Light weapons</a></span></h2>
<p>Weapons of short to medium range and equal damage, light weapons can be used mostly when there are wounds in the arms.
</p><p>The vast majority of members of this classification lack the ability to pierce armor.
</p>

<h2><span class="mw-headline" id="Heavy_weapons"><a href="/wiki/Category:Heavy_weapons" title="Category:Heavy weapons">Heavy weapons</a></span></h2>
<p>Long range and great destructive power, heavy weapons ensure the destruction of the enemy with their immense firepower and thanks to the fact that most can pierce armor. Due to their size and weight, very few members of this classification can be used if the survivor injures an arm. 
</p>
